title: The Vera Project

services.name: Screen Printing
services.desc: Vera’s screen print studio offers people of all ages, identities, and skill levels the opportunity to learn the art and science of screen printing. Whether you want to print shirts, posters, comics, or something else, our instructors and studio moderators are practicing designers and artists committed to developing the creative skills of the Seattle community. Never tried screen printing before? No problem! We have classes to help you build a familiarity with the screen printing process so that you can get in and get your hands dirty in no time!
